validity.data_after_timer_end: Retained in source recording, excluded from labelled phase comparisons

timing_adjustments.scope: Preserve confirmed physical condition and raw full phase. Do not treat scheduled pre-cue interval as actual contact. Adjust settled window conservatively to three seconds after host cue receipt; its duration is shorter than the other repetitions.

operator_environment.moisture_source: Direct operator observation; not a measured moisture value

timing_annotation.scope: Preserve confirmed physical condition and raw full phase. Do not treat scheduled pre-cue interval as actual contact. Adjust settled window conservatively to three seconds after host cue receipt; its duration is shorter than the other repetitions.

operator_audio: Black-only and paired audible in all three repetitions, sustained, no perceived change when plant was added; reported silence after release.

data_quality.meaning: Flags missing host-received telemetry, including phase boundaries; does not prove a node reboot or missing analogue response.

operator_ack_delay_warnings.meaning: Host receipt delay; not an instrumented physical touch onset or audio emission timestamp.

interpretation: Shared activation occurs before plant contact. Adding plant does not create a clearly separate audible effect in this trial. Third contact remains valid with a documented delayed visible cue; its shorter settled window is not equivalent in duration to the first two.
limitations: Actual physical onset/release not electronically instrumented.
MIDI held time is not measured audio duration.
Zero unsigned ADC summaries do not establish zero analogue voltage.
